faq.q: What is the best time to visit Majuli?
faq.a: The best time to visit Majuli is Oct – Mar. Summers are 22–32°C and winters are 10–22°C.

The nearest airport is Majuli / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Dimapur Railway Station (124 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Majuli?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Majuli at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Majuli?
faq.a: Stays in Majuli start from ₹1,000 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Majuli?
faq.a: The top attractions are Kamalabari Satra, Mask Making at Samaguri, Brahmaputra Sunset Point.
